title: Palace of the Governors, Togo
scope: The exterior of the restored Palais de Lomé, with its unequal towers, eight-arch seaward frontage, upper teak galleries, attached terrace, and four sides of the open central courtyard.
limitations: An exterior reconstruction of the standing palace. Tower levels, small rear openings and the decorative metalwork are estimated from the available references. The garden, detached pavilions and interior galleries are outside the building model.
